top_choice_rationale: P001 awards Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for the physiology of GLP-1 and the identification of its active form. The discovery chain (proglucagon processing and secretion, GLP-1 and receptor biology, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide) preceded any drug and has been replicated for decades. Large randomized trials in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease show it is mature. The three names each have a distinct discovery-side claim. The citation says 'identification of its active form' and does not name a sole originator, which keeps the contested priority question open. The remaining weakness is attribution: Habener is outside the credited names and Knudsen is left out. No award is clearly worse than this configuration.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my profile records no connection to Drucker, Holst, Mojsov or Knudsen
